name: todo
description: Per-directory todo backlog: add titles, exec them into subagents or Workflow trees, and drive everything from a right-hand pane

doneTtlMinutes.title: Done todo lifetime (minutes)
doneTtlMinutes.description: How long a done todo stays in the pane's tree before it's hidden; 0 keeps them. The CLAUDE_TODO_DONE_TTL_MINUTES environment variable overrides it.
